Carrd is a one-page site builder. With Pro Standard, you can publish a signup page on your own domain and send captured names and email addresses to the platform you use.

The Pro page lists the available form connections, plan features, and a **7-day trial** of top Pro features such as custom domains and advanced forms. No payment or credit card is required for the trial.
